THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the day of January 2006 by and between Haleakala, Inc., a not-for-profit corporation having an office and place of business at c/o The Kitchen, 512 West 19h Street, New York, New York 10011, Attn: Debra Singer (*Owner"), and 516 WEST 19h LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address c/o Bishopcourt Realty LLC, 430 West 14h Street, 5th Floor, New York, New York 10014 Attn: John Jacobson (*Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 40 in Block 690 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 512 West 19" Street, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known asLot 42 in Block 690 on the TaxMap of the City of NewYork,and as and by the street address 516-522 West 19h Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (as hereinafter defined) are being merged into a single zoning lot as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building, and to construct a new building and other associated improvements on the Developer Land and/or any Developer Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined) (such new building and associated improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement,are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Developer Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined);
